title: test: scope the tree-wide pin scans to the extensions they judge, one shared scan per file
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DTUQ4EBM66nvHr5WDUjGwSA)_

Fixes #25321

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

The four tree-scan pins that still handed `git grep` all of `packages/` and filtered to `.ts` afterwards now give git the pathspec of the extension they judge, and run that scan once per file, shared by every assertion that reads it. This is the shape PR #25319 gave the `@objectstack/runtime` twin. `SCAN_TIMEOUT_MS = 60_000` is unchanged in every file: this is not a timeout raise.

Test-only; `skip-changeset` (all four files are `src/**/*.test.ts`, which neither package ships: both `files[]` ship `dist`).

## Adopted from a fork PR

The core of this diff is the fork PR #25389 by Nitjsefnie, adopted onto an internal branch per the repository's card-first rule for outside contributions. Its first commit carries their diff unchanged, with `Co-authored-by: Nitjsefnie`. The fork PR itself is not landed; it is closed with thanks when this card closes.

The second commit is the review change. The fork made the `@objectstack/objectql` twin one scan too, but kept a second file read per symbol and dropped the attribution check. That file now carries the runtime twin's half D as it stands on `main`:

- one multi-needle `git grep` over `SCANNED_PATHSPECS` in the describe's `beforeAll`;
- the candidate files are read once, recording each symbol's lines;
- a file git lists but the read cannot attribute throws (a broken scan, never a clean file);
- the two tree tests drop their own `SCAN_TIMEOUT_MS`, because they no longer scan;
- `SCAN_TIMEOUT_MS` keeps the runtime twin's "not a dial" note.

The two copies are kept parallel on purpose (PR #25319's acceptance note). The remaining differences from the runtime twin are the package-specific ones (`findUp` for the CJS root, `PIN_FILES[0]`, the runtime site as the reach target, no half lettering) and comment wording that already differed on `main`.

## Per file

| file | before | after |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `packages/objectql/src/action-owner-key-single-source.test.ts` | 3 greps over `packages` | 1 grep, `:(glob)packages/**/*.ts`, both needles |
| `packages/core/src/security/row-serving-door-exposure.pin.test.ts` | 2 greps over `packages` | 1 grep, `*.ts`, in `beforeAll` |
| `packages/core/src/security/second-object-read-exposure.pin.test.ts` | 2 greps over `packages` | 1 grep, `*.ts`, in `beforeAll` |
| `packages/core/src/security/operation-private-keys.pin.test.ts` | 4 prefilter greps over `packages` (+3 `ls-files`) | 1 prefilter grep, `*.ts` + `*.tsx`, in `beforeAll` (the `ls-files` census is untouched) |
| `packages/core/src/security/granted-permissions-not-enforced.pin.test.ts` | already `*.ts` + `*.mts` | **unchanged** |

`operation-private-keys` keeps `.tsx` in its prefilter on purpose: the boundary-expiry assertion judges `.tsx` declarations, so that population must still be read.

## Readings (local container, base `830a63a`, head `98ac499`)

Bytes are `rchar` from `/proc/PID/io` for the git processes each file starts, with the test's own arguments. Wall is the vitest JSON reporter's file duration, 3 runs each, under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`.

| file | git invocations | bytes git reads | file wall (3 runs) |
| :-- | --: | --: | --: |
| objectql twin | 3 → 1 | 639.7 → 151.8 MB | 391 / 405 / 402 → 156 / 181 / 176 ms |
| row-serving | 2 → 1 | 426.5 → 151.8 MB | 374 / 337 / 371 → 141 / 139 / 120 ms |
| second-object | 2 → 1 | 426.5 → 151.8 MB | 501 / 475 / 467 → 233 / 259 / 231 ms |
| operation-private-keys | 4 greps + 3 `ls-files` → 1 + 3 | 852.9 → 151.9 MB | 856 / 863 / 892 → 142 / 151 / 145 ms |
| granted-permissions (unchanged) | 7 | 1,065.3 MB | 529 / 519 / 509 → 547 / 533 / 545 ms |

The local wall cannot reproduce a loaded shard. **Estimate, not measured on a shard:** if a shard's cost scales with the bytes read, as the runtime twin's 86.24 s across three walks suggests, each edited file now reads what one walk read there.

### The judged file set did not shrink: measured

Old shape (grep over `packages`, then the file's own filter) against new shape (pathspec grep, then the same filter), on the head tree plus untracked plants under `packages/zz-eq-25321/` holding every needle: `top.ts` (depth 1), `a/b/deep.ts`, `a/b/deep.d.ts`, `a/b/z.test.ts`, `a/b/x.tsx`, `a/b/y.mts`, `a/b/note.md` (depth 3).

| pin | judged set | old | new | | plants kept |
| :-- | :-- | --: | --: | :-- | :-- |
| objectql twin | `actionObjectKey` | 6 | 6 | identical | `top.ts`, `deep.ts`, `deep.d.ts`, `z.test.ts` |
| objectql twin | `standaloneActionOwnerKey` | 15 | 15 | identical | the same four |
| row-serving | `canReadObject` | 19 | 19 | identical | `top.ts`, `deep.ts` |
| second-object | `referenceTargetOf` | 24 | 24 | identical | `top.ts`, `deep.ts` |
| operation-private-keys | offender population (`.ts` minus `.d.ts`) | 17 | 17 | identical | `top.ts`, `deep.ts`, `z.test.ts` |
| operation-private-keys | boundary population (`.tsx`) | 1 | 1 | identical | `x.tsx` |

The plants were removed by a trap, and `git status` was clean afterwards.

### A planted mention in a still-scanned path goes red

Predicted direction: red, naming the planted file. Each leg plants one untracked file under `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/zz-ablation-25321/deep/er/` and runs that pin file alone at head `98ac499`, after the fix was committed.

| pin | plant | result |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| objectql twin | `planted.ts`, a comment naming `actionObjectKey` | 1 failed, 4 passed: "is named nowhere outside the release record…", listing `…/deep/er/planted.ts:1` |
| objectql twin | control: the same text as `planted.md` | 5 passed |
| row-serving | `planted.ts` calling `svc.canReadObject(…)` | 1 failed, 2 passed: "every caller of the read admission is classified…", listing the plant |
| row-serving | control: `.md` | 3 passed |
| second-object | `planted.ts` calling `referenceTargetOf(…)` | 1 failed, 3 passed: "every caller of the reference-target arbiter is classified…", listing the plant |
| second-object | control: `.md` | 4 passed |
| operation-private-keys | `planted.ts` declaring `OPERATION_PRIVATE_KEY_PREFIX` | 1 failed, 4 passed: "is declared in exactly one file…", listing the plant |
| operation-private-keys | the same declaration as `planted.tsx` | 1 failed, 4 passed: the boundary assertion "the extension boundary is `.ts` alone…", listing the plant; the offender assertion stays green |
| operation-private-keys | control: `.md` | 5 passed |

The plant directory was removed by a trap after every leg; `git status --porcelain` and `git diff HEAD` were empty afterwards.

## Local verification (head `98ac499`)

- The five pin files pass: objectql 5/5, row-serving 3/3, second-object 4/4, operation-private-keys 5/5, granted-permissions 6/6 (`vitest run --project repo`, per file).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/core run typecheck`: exit 0. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql run typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` on the four files: exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 58 families; `--ran` reconciliation: 58 accounted for, 53 run, 5 NOT MEASURED (exit 3, no `dist/` in this container: `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content`; `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test`, whose pinned fixture commit is outside the shallow clone). `check-engine-split-ratio --days 90` exited 2, refusing the shallow clone's 90-day window: also NOT MEASURED here. Their verdicts are this PR's CI checks.
- `scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --test` on the four paths: 0 of 4 hit the register, NOT governed.

## Acceptance notes

- **`granted-permissions-not-enforced.pin.test.ts` is left unchanged, as the card asks** (its pathspecs are already `.ts` + `.mts`). It is now the largest reader of the five: seven separate scoped greps, 1,065.3 MB per file run. The test "leaves the fs and network grant classes with no enforcement surface at all" runs three of them (about 456 MB) inside one 60 s budget, which is more than the 426 MB a single test of the runtime twin read before it timed out on a loaded shard. It has not been seen red. The same one-shared-scan shape would fit it. Noted, not filed; carrier: none.
- The fork PR showed 0 check runs at its head `f38d888`, read as NOT MEASURED. This branch's CI is the first measurement of the adopted diff.
- **Branch name.** This PR's branch is `claude/project-thread-37l85m`, the name the session was given, not `claude/issue-25321-…`. The Duplicate Fix Guard may say so. The claim (comment 6364199079) names it.
